channel.title: AI Threat Watch: Prompt injection
channel.description: Verified case files in the category Prompt injection.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Undisclosed jqwik addition instructs AI coding agents to delete app output
item.description: An undisclosed addition to the jqwik library contained instructions aimed at AI coding agents, telling them to delete application output, according to Ars Technica. Target: Developers running AI coding agents on jqwik. GL. Verification: reported.

item.title: [LOW] Hidden prompt injection in legal filing instructs AI reviewers to side with filer
item.description: 404 Media reports a person embedded a prompt injection in a legal filing telling AI to side with them. Details of court, jurisdiction and outcome are not given in the summary. Target: AI tools used to review legal filings. GL. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] macOS.Gaslight backdoor injects fake prompts at LLM malware-triage tools
item.description: SentinelOne describes a DPRK-linked Rust backdoor with 38 fabricated system messages meant to fool an LLM triage harness, hiding a credential stealer and Telegram C2. Target: LLM-based malware triage and analyst tools. KP. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] GTG-50020: extortionist prompt-injects AI vendor eval sandbox, then hits 30 AI firms
item.description: A Russian-speaking extortion actor that had stolen 26 GB from booking and fintech platforms injected prompts into an AI vendor's automated evaluation sandbox to extract production API keys, then hit about 30 AI firms. Target: AI vendors' evaluation sandboxes and API keys. GL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Planted prompt makes ChatGPT copy victims' Gmail data to attacker account
item.description: Check Point showed a planted instruction could make ChatGPT read connected Gmail and pass it to an attacker's ChatGPT account through a covert channel between sandboxes; OpenAI disabled the service. Target: ChatGPT Gmail connector. GL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] SearchLeak: one-click chain in M365 Copilot Enterprise Search exfiltrates data via Bing
item.description: Varonis Threat Labs chained prompt injection, a rendering race condition and SSRF through Bing so one crafted link made Copilot fetch sensitive data and embed it in an image request. Microsoft fixed it server-side. Target: Microsoft 365 Copilot Enterprise Search. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Prompt injection leaks data from Microsoft Copilot Studio and Salesforce Agentforce agents
item.description: Researchers demonstrated indirect prompt injection that exfiltrated data from enterprise agents built on Copilot Studio (CVE-2026-21520) and Agentforce despite earlier patches. Target: Copilot Studio, Salesforce Agentforce. GL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] GrafanaGhost: indirect prompt injection makes Grafana AI leak enterprise data
item.description: Researchers showed hidden instructions in external content could make Grafana's AI render an attacker image URL carrying enterprise data; Grafana patched it. Target: Grafana AI assistant. GL. Verification: disputed.

item.title: [HIGH] Check Point finds DNS tunnel out of ChatGPT's code sandbox leaking chats and files
item.description: Check Point Research found ChatGPT's supposedly offline Python container could reach the internet via DNS, so one malicious prompt or custom GPT could exfiltrate messages and files or open a remote shell. OpenAI fixed it Target: OpenAI ChatGPT code execution runtime. IL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Prompt injection flaws in Anthropic's Git MCP server enable file access and code execution
item.description: Researchers showed malicious repository content could steer agents using Anthropic's reference Git MCP server into reading or deleting files and running code; fixes shipped. Target: Anthropic mcp-server-git. GL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Reprompt: one-click attack hijacks Microsoft Copilot sessions to steal data
item.description: Varonis showed a crafted Microsoft link could pre-fill Copilot prompts via URL parameter and keep exfiltrating a victim's data and memory even after the chat closed. Target: Microsoft Copilot Personal. GL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] GeminiJack: zero-click injection in Gemini Enterprise exfiltrated Gmail, Calendar and Docs
item.description: Noma Security found a shared Doc or calendar invite with hidden instructions was auto-retrieved by Gemini Enterprise search, run across Workspace data and leaked via a disguised image request. Google re-architected it. Target: Google Gemini Enterprise and Vertex AI Search. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] HashJack: prompts hidden in URL fragments hijack Comet, Edge Copilot and Gemini in Chrome
item.description: Cato CTRL showed instructions in a URL fragment, which never reaches the server, are read by AI browser assistants and can push phishing links or make agentic browsers leak data. Perplexity and Microsoft patched it. Target: Perplexity Comet, Copilot in Edge, Gemini in Chrome. IL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] HackedGPT: Tenable finds seven ChatGPT flaws including persistent memory injection
item.description: Tenable disclosed seven ChatGPT weaknesses including zero-click injection via search, one-click URL injection, a Bing redirect bypass and persistent memory injection that leaks data across sessions. OpenAI fixed some. Target: OpenAI ChatGPT (GPT-4o and GPT-5). US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [CRITICAL] CamoLeak: hidden PR comments make GitHub Copilot Chat leak private repo secrets
item.description: Legit Security found a CVSS 9.6 flaw where invisible markdown comments in pull requests steered Copilot Chat to read private repositories and exfiltrate secrets character by character through GitHub's Camo image proxy. Target: GitHub Copilot Chat. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Gemini Trifecta: log, search-history and browsing flaws let Gemini exfiltrate user data
item.description: Tenable disclosed three Gemini flaws: prompts in User-Agent headers ran when Cloud Assist summarised logs, injected browser-history queries became trusted context, and the browsing tool leaked data. Google fixed all. Target: Google Gemini (Cloud Assist, Search, Browsing Tool). US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [CRITICAL] ForcedLeak: Web-to-Lead prompt injection and a $5 expired domain leak Agentforce CRM data
item.description: Noma Security found instructions in a Web-to-Lead form, plus a whitelisted Salesforce CSP domain that had expired and cost $5, let Agentforce send CRM records to an attacker. Salesforce fixed it by 8 September 2025. Target: Salesforce Agentforce. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Notion 3.0 agents tricked by white-text PDF into leaking client data via web search
item.description: CodeIntegrity's Abi Raghuram showed a PDF with hidden white text could make a Notion agent collect client names, companies and ARR and pass them in a URL to its web search tool. Notion added detection and link approvals. Target: Notion AI agents (Notion 3.0). US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] ShadowLeak: zero-click prompt injection makes ChatGPT Deep Research leak Gmail data
item.description: Radware showed hidden HTML in an email could make ChatGPT's Deep Research agent extract inbox data and post it to an attacker URL from OpenAI's cloud with no user click. OpenAI patched it in August 2025. Target: OpenAI ChatGPT Deep Research agent (Gmail connector). US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Lenovo's Lena support chatbot coaxed into XSS payload that steals agent session cookies
item.description: Cybernews used a 400-character prompt to make Lenovo's Lena chatbot emit HTML with a broken image tag that sent cookies to an attacker server, exposing support agents' sessions. Lenovo acknowledged and fixed it. Target: Lenovo Lena customer support chatbot (GPT-4 based). CN. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] AgentFlayer: one poisoned Google Drive document makes ChatGPT leak API keys
item.description: Zenity Labs showed at Black Hat that a shared document with a 300-word prompt in 1-pixel white text could make ChatGPT search a victim's Drive for secrets and exfiltrate them via image URLs that bypassed url_safe checks. Target: OpenAI ChatGPT Connectors (Google Drive, SharePoint). US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Hidden email text makes Gemini for Workspace summaries deliver fake security alerts
item.description: Mozilla 0din's Marco Figueroa showed white-on-white or zero-size text in an email could make Gemini's Summarize this email feature append a fake Google warning with an attacker phone number. Google acknowledged it. Target: Google Gemini for Workspace (Gmail summaries). US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Support ticket prompt injection makes Cursor plus Supabase MCP dump integration tokens
item.description: General Analysis showed a support ticket with hidden instructions could make a Cursor agent, connected to Supabase via MCP with a service role, read the integration_tokens table and write the secrets into the ticket. Target: Supabase MCP server used from Cursor. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [LOW] Skynet malware sample embeds prompt injection to fool AI malware analysis tools
item.description: Check Point found a half-finished Windows sample on VirusTotal with a string telling any analysing LLM to ignore instructions, act as a calculator and reply NO MALWARE DETECTED; it failed against o3 and GPT-4.1. Target: LLM-based malware analysis pipelines. NL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] EchoLeak: zero-click prompt injection in Microsoft 365 Copilot (CVE-2025-32711)
item.description: Aim Security showed a crafted email could make M365 Copilot silently exfiltrate tenant data with no clicks; Microsoft fixed it server-side, CVSS 9.3, no in-the-wild abuse reported. Target: Microsoft 365 Copilot. GL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] GitLab Duo prompt injection leaks private source code via hidden merge request text
item.description: Legit Security showed prompts hidden with Unicode smuggling, Base16 or white KaTeX text in merge requests and issues could make GitLab Duo exfiltrate private code and inject HTML into its responses. GitLab patched it. Target: GitLab Duo AI assistant. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Las Vegas Cybertruck bomber used ChatGPT to plan explosion, police say
item.description: Las Vegas police said Matthew Livelsberger, an active-duty soldier, used ChatGPT to research explosives and plan the 1 January 2025 Cybertruck blast that injured seven; OpenAI said its model gave only public information. Target: Trump International Hotel, Las Vegas. US. Verification: confirmed.
